stemMd: Let f(x)=x+2 and g(x)=x squared. What is f(g(3))?
explanationMd: Evaluate inside out: g(3)=9, then f(9)=11. Composition is order-sensitive; reversing it gives 25 rather than 11.

distractorRationale.d: This computes g(f(3)), reversing the order.
distractorRationale.e: This multiplies intermediate terms without following the definitions.
distractorRationale.a: This stops after the inner function.
distractorRationale.c: This adds 4 instead of 2 after squaring.
